short_description: A rhyming read-aloud with your child’s name in six rhymes, a dedication and a family reading pledge. Four character looks. Hardcover or softcover.
long_description:
Laps Not Apps is a warm, rhyming read-aloud about the best seats in town, made for one child. Their name is woven into six of the rhymes: Dad calls them up to the armchair, Grandma saves them a seat, a big brother gives them a turn to sing “QUACK!”, and a sleepy “Goodnight” comes at the end of the day.

You choose one of four looks for the story’s child, their pronouns, and who the book is from. The first page is a personal dedication with your own gift message (or our warm default). Every spread has a short “Lap talk” idea for grown-ups: pause and wait, say what you see and add one word, offer a choice, or stop before the fun word so your child can fill it in.

At the back you will find 5 simple lap games with safety notes, a “Books before screens” family reading pledge to sign together, and a keepsake page for your child’s favorite laps. The cast is diverse and modern, including a grandmother who uses a wheelchair.

Each copy is printed on demand for your child in 8.5 x 8.5 inch full color, as a hardcover or a softcover. It makes a lasting baby-shower, first-birthday or grandparent gift.

compliance_notes: No health or medical claims: the book is a story plus parent education and claims to treat, prevent or diagnose nothing. No autism or diagnosis wording anywhere (book, keywords, listing). Not presented as written by a speech-language pathologist or clinician. Talk strategies use plain words only, with no trademarked program names. No real brands, apps or products; the only screen is a generic phone resting face-down. No research citations. Child safety: every lap game has adult supervision and a safety line; the safety box covers the small-parts rule for under-3s (toilet-paper-tube test, about 1.25 in / 3.2 cm), no balloons, no cords, car seats (never a lap in a car), safe sleep, and stopping when the child says no. Copyright page: “© 2026 AlphaPlay LLC. Play Before Pixels is a trade name of AlphaPlay LLC.”, the website (own-site edition only), “First edition 2026 · Version 1.0 · September 2026”, and “Read together, and keep books away from mouths.” No street address is printed: the old Rockville Pike mailbox is retired and the founder’s home address must never appear (legal/ENTITY.md). If a printer or EU/UK GPSR needs a postal address, use the USPS PO Box once it exists [VERIFY]. Logo from brand/logo (horizontal lockup; one-colour white on the tomato band). Customer text is HTML-escaped, length-limited and checked for printable characters; anything unusual stops before printing and goes to the weekly review. Privacy: the child’s name is used only to print; it is not added to marketing, not committed to git, and order files are deleted after delivery [VERIFY retention with counsel]. Personalized items: state the no-change-of-mind-returns policy and misprint reprints before checkout [VERIFY the printer’s policy]. The final files must be checked against the chosen printer’s current template (Lulu, Gelato or other) before upload: trim, bleed, minimum page count, cover dimensions and spine, and CMYK/PDF-X if required. CPSIA: confirm the ordinary-book exemption applies; UK/EU: GPSR responsible person before selling there [VERIFY]. Etsy edition: no URL and no QR code (customer-voice rule 2); the build switches automatically on channel "etsy". Customer text is typeset with curly quotes and apostrophes.
